attachments.title: Resident Evil 4 on Oculus Quest
attachments.text: Return to the classic survival horror title, Resident Evil 4, rebuilt entirely for VR. Play as special agent Leon S. Kennedy, in true first person POV, as he's sent on a mission to a mysterious European village to rescue the U.S. President's daughter.
